summary: The 8-K reports the issuance of an unsecured promissory note by Churchill Capital Corp XI (a SPAC) to its sponsor, Churchill Sponsor XI LLC, for up to $1.5M to fund working capital. The note bears no interest, matures upon the earlier of a business combination or liquidation, and is convertible at the sponsor's option into units at $10.00/unit, identical to private placement units from the IPO. This is a routine financing arrangement for a blank-check company, not a special situation. The filing has no deal terms, premium, or board recommendation; it reflects ordinary SPAC operations and does not trigger an M&A or restructuring category.
